_comment: Registry for emu/play.sh. The manager fills in each game's verified disk image. Paths are relative to the repo root.

narrowscreen.title: Narrow Screen test disk (System 6.0 + Narrow Screen)
narrowscreen.controls: Mouse. Apple menu > Control Panel > Narrow Screen to adjust margins.

racer.title: Endurance
racer.controls: Mouse steers, button accelerates (or A/D steer, W/Space gas, S brake; arrows/X/Z also work). Return starts, P pauses, M sound on/off, Esc back to title / quit.

runner.title: Rail Runner
runner.controls: A/D: change lanes, W: jump, S: roll, Space: hoverboard (arrow keys work too). Return: start. M: sound on/off. Esc: back to the title, or quit from the title.

doodle.title: Doodle (paint + Finish it)
doodle.controls: Mouse. Draw inside the dotted frame, click Finish it (Cmd-F), type what it is (e.g. cat), press Return; click to stop, Undo removes it. Finish menu: Tidy / Normal / Wild.

pixel.title: Pixel the chatbot
pixel.controls: Type a message and press Return, or use Edit > Keyboard… to type with the mouse. Pixel takes about 75 s to load in the emulator.

pixel_se.title: Pixel the chatbot (Macintosh SE, System 7, hard disk)
pixel_se.controls: Type a message and press Return, or use Edit > Keyboard… to type with the mouse.

blockworld.title: Blockworld
blockworld.status: ready (M7: starts at once in a ready-made world; New world in the Esc menu makes another in about a minute)
blockworld.controls: Mouse looks, button mines and hits; W A S D move, Space jumps (or swims up), E places / uses / eats / shoots the bow, Shift+E places against a workbench, 1-9 pick the hotbar slot, Tab the inventory, V the view distance, Esc the menu (save and quit), M sound on/off.

blockworld_se.title: Blockworld (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
blockworld_se.status: ready (same game; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy)

dream.title: Dream (tiny diffusion model, 4 MB)
dream.controls: Type a subject (e.g. house) and press Return, or click Dream; Return with an empty box or Surprise me picks one of 220. The picture develops from static in 6 steps (about 95 s on a real Plus); click to stop after the current step. File menu: Copy Picture, Save as MacPaint. Loads its model for about 55 s first.

dream_1mb.title: Dream (1 MB Plus, 32x32)
dream_1mb.controls: Same as Dream, at 32x32 with 191 subjects (about 48 s per picture on a real Plus).

dream_se.title: Dream (Macintosh SE, 1.44 MB floppy)
dream_se.status: ready (same app and model; System 6.0.7 SE boot floppy)
dream_se.controls: As Dream (about 85 s per picture on a real SE).
